name: foundry-workers
description: Pins the Claude Code CLI, playwright-core, corepack and bats installed into the worker and login images (see Dockerfile.base). playwright-core downloads no browser; it drives the image's Chromium. corepack provides the npm, npx, pnpm and yarn shims that follow a repository's packageManager pin. bats runs a repository's .bats suites. Dependabot bumps all four.
